title: What Is Liquidity? Why Some Coins Are Hard to Sell
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Liquidity describes how easily an asset can be bought or sold without moving its price much. Sources: Investopedia, Coinbase Learn. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: CAN YOU SELL IT?
scenes.narration: Owning a coin is one thing. Being able to sell it at a fair price is another. That is liquidity.

scenes.head: WHAT IS LIQUIDITY?
scenes.narration: Liquidity means how easily something can be bought or sold without moving its price much. Busy markets usually have more of it.

scenes.head: HIGH LIQUIDITY
scenes.narration: When many people trade a coin, there are always orders waiting on both sides. Prices tend to move more smoothly.

scenes.head: LOW LIQUIDITY
scenes.narration: With few traders, even one large order can push the price a lot. You may get a worse price than you expected.

scenes.head: WHAT TO CHECK
scenes.narration: Beginners can look at trading volume, the gap between buy and sell prices, and how many places list the coin.

scenes.head: REMEMBER
scenes.narration: Liquidity can dry up fast in stressful times, and hype is not the same as real trading. This is education, not advice.
